description: The bookable windows for a product over a date range, per resource, with what is already taken. Quote times from THIS — never compute a grid yourself: the engine applies the hours, the buffer, notice and advance limits, and the outlet timezone, and a hold whose start is not exactly a slot start is refused. Ask for a few days at a time; a year-wide range is slow and pointless.

from.description: ISO instant, start of the range, e.g. "2026-09-12T00:00:00Z"

outletId.description: The shop the booking is for — decides the local wall clock. Omit for the company default

to.description: ISO instant, end of the range

name: hub_get_booking_availability
title: Check booking availability
